items.source: If a matching ApplicationListener does not support asynchronous execution, it must be run within the calling thread of this multicast call.
items.translation: 如果匹配的 `ApplicationListener` 不支持异步执行，则必须在本次多播调用的调用线程中运行。

items.source: event - the event to multicast
items.translation: event - 要组播的事件

items.source: An ApplicationEventPublisher, typically a Spring ApplicationContext, can use an ApplicationEventMulticaster as a delegate for actually publishing events.
items.translation: 一个 `ApplicationEventPublisher`，通常是 Spring 的 `ApplicationContext`，可以使用一个 `ApplicationEventMulticaster` 作为委托来实际发布事件。

items.source: If the eventType is null, a default type is built based on the event instance.
items.translation: 如果 `eventType` 为 `null`，则根据 `event` 实例构建默认类型。

items.source: Consider using multicastEvent(ApplicationEvent, ResolvableType) if possible as it provides better support for generics-based events.
items.translation: 如果可能，请考虑使用multicastEvent(ApplicationEvent, ResolvableType)，因为它为基于泛型的事件提供了更好的支持。

items.source: Add a listener to be notified of all events.
items.translation: 添加一个监听器以接收所有事件的通知。

items.source: Add a listener bean to be notified of all events.
items.translation: 添加一个监听器 Bean 以接收所有事件的通知。

items.source: Multicast the given application event to appropriate listeners.
items.translation: 将给定的应用程序事件广播到适当的监听器。

items.source: Remove a listener from the notification list.
items.translation: 从通知列表中移除监听器。

items.source: Remove a listener bean from the notification list.
items.translation: 从通知列表中移除监听器 Bean。

items.source: eventType - the type of event (can be null)
items.translation: eventType - 事件类型（可为 null）

items.source: Note: This just applies to bean name registrations, not to programmatically registered ApplicationListener instances.
items.translation: 注意：这仅适用于 Bean 名称注册，不适用于程序化注册的 `ApplicationListener` 实例。

items.source:
Note: This just applies to instance registrations, not to listeners
registered by bean name.
items.translation: 注意：此规则仅适用于实例注册，不适用于通过 Bean 名称注册的监听器。

items.source:
After a remove call, the multicaster will perform no action
on event notification until new listeners are registered.
items.translation: 在调用 remove 后，多播器将在注册新监听器之前，不会执行任何事件通知操作。

items.source: Remove all matching listeners from the set of registered ApplicationListener instances (which includes adapter classes such as ApplicationListenerMethodAdapter, for example, for annotated EventListener methods).
items.translation: 从已注册的 `ApplicationListener` 实例集合中移除所有匹配的监听器（其中包括适配器类，例如用于带有注解的 EventListener 方法的 ApplicationListenerMethodAdapter）。

items.source: Remove all matching listener beans from the set of registered listener bean names (referring to bean classes which in turn implement the ApplicationListener interface directly).
items.translation: 从已注册的监听器 Bean 名称集合中移除所有匹配的监听器 Bean（指直接实现ApplicationListener接口的 Bean 类）。

items.source: Remove all listeners registered with this multicaster.
items.translation: 移除与此多播器注册的所有监听器。

items.source: predicate - the predicate to identify listener instances to remove, for example, checking SmartApplicationListener.getListenerId()
items.translation: `predicate` - 用于标识要移除的监听器实例的谓词，例如检查SmartApplicationListener.getListenerId()。

items.source: listener - the listener to add
items.translation: listener - 要添加的监听器

items.source: listenerBeanName - the name of the listener bean to add
items.translation: listenerBeanName - 要添加的监听器 Bean 的名称

items.source: listener - the listener to remove
items.translation: listener - 要移除的监听器

items.source: listenerBeanName - the name of the listener bean to remove
items.translation: listenerBeanName - 要移除的监听器 Bean 的名称

items.source: predicate - the predicate to identify listener bean names to remove
items.translation: predicate - 用于标识要移除的监听器 Bean 名称的谓词

items.source: Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller, Stephane Nicoll
items.translation: Rod Johnson、Juergen Hoeller 和 Stephane Nicoll
